subject: Urgent: FastCart p99 spikes + 429 retry amplification (hosted API)
messages:
From: Mike Liao <mike.liao@fastcart.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: elena@fastcart.com
Date: 2026-05-27T18:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted API - sudden p99 regressions and 429s

Sean —

We started seeing a large uptick in errors this afternoon. P95 is slightly up but p99 is spiking to 3–4x normal and some calls are returning 429s repeatedly. Our clients are timing out and retrying aggressively which seems to make it worse (more 429s). We collected a short sample and attached logs.

This started around 16:45 PDT. Can you confirm whether there were any infra changes or throttling adjustments on your side? Our checkout flow is failing for ~8% of users on heavy traffic. We’re on org key FASTCART-PROD.

We need immediate mitigation and an ETA on a fix. This is customer-facing and losing revenue.

—Mike
Senior SRE, FastCart

Attachment: service-logs-20260527.tar.gz (3 files, text)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Mike Liao <mike.liao@fastcart.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-27T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API - sudden p99 regressions and 429s

Mike — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We’re on it. I’ve looped in Rishi (runtime/SRE) and Hannah (CS escalation). Initial ask: can you stop client retries for requests that return 429 for the next 15 minutes? If clients back off, it reduces retry amplification and lets us triage.

Immediate actions from our side: 1) Rishi will check routing/backpressure and any rate-limit rule changes; 2) we’ll examine the KV cache pressure and hot-shard signals; 3) Hannah will coordinate an outage channel and keep you updated every 30 minutes.

I’ll escalate to leadership if we need an account-level mitigation (VIP routing / temporary quota bump).

—Sean
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-27T18:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API - sudden p99 regressions and 429s

Quick summary after initial triage:
- No deploys in the US-hosted fleet during the window (checked control plane).
- Control-plane rate-limit config stable; however, we are observing bursty inbound fanout from FASTCART-PROD that exceeds their normal token distribution (spikes of 2.5x for ~5m).
- Telemetry shows a climb in queue wait times on the shared routing tier leading to elevated p99.
- We’re seeing a classic retry-amplification pattern: clients get 429, retry immediately with insufficient backoff, traffic concentrates and increases queue depth, which increases both p95/p99 and 429s.

Immediate mitigations I recommend (we can do now):
1) Apply temporary soft quota increase for FASTCART-PROD for the next 60 minutes (+30%).
2) Create a route pin to less-loaded serving pool for critical keys (VIP routing).
3) Enforce a mild per-key circuit-breaker (short cooldown) for aggressive retryers.

I’ll push the quota and routing change after Sean confirms. I’ll also attach a snapshot (slo_snapshot-20260527.png) to the incident.

—Rishi
Lead Infra Reliability
